verdict.rationale: Manufact is a hosting and observability platform that stores gateway request data, so data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The only related evidence is an opt-in toggle that controls whether full request and response bodies are captured. That is an adjacent control over what gets collected, not a documented way to set retention periods or delete stored data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Toggle Capture payloads to also store full request and response bodies for each event
